notes: Development-only basis-order and partial-coverage necessity audit. L=3 is the frozen physics span [1,1/v,1/v^2]; L=4..7 append nested powers of normalized speed. Each candidate space is orthogonalized by a fixed QR transform on a 401-point 10--30 m/s reference grid, avoiding arbitrary residual-center ordering and improving conditioning without changing the represented span. Targets are exact discrete Jacobians of the nonlinear tanh-tire plant about feasible steady-cornering equilibria. Whole contiguous speed blocks are withheld. L is chosen by the one-standard-error rule on fleet-level blocked-speed errors, subject to conditioning; errors below the 0.01% practical floor are treated as equivalent so numerical noise cannot reward needless terms. Straight-line curvature is a negative control. Partial client blocks are used only for rank/conditioning diagnostics; no federated accuracy comparison is made in 10A.
